Title: Transition to the ContainerLogV2 table by 30 September 2026

Body.Content:
On 30 September 2026, we'll retire the ContainerLog table in Azure Monitor container insights and you'll need to transition to the ContainerLogV2 table. The ContainerLogV2 table offers all the functionality of ContainerLog, plus:

  • Compatibility with the basic logs pricing tier.
  • Additional pod and container metadata for easier querying.
  • Support for multiline log entries.

To ensure your alerts and dashboards continue to work as expected, transition to ContainerLogV2 by 30 September 2026.
